mission: Certify that DreamCo builds, runs, routes, connects, deploys, recovers, and meets speed/accuracy requirements with explicit evidence instead of file-existence assumptions.
connection_rule: A named integration is not fully connected until a successful runtime probe is completed with authorization. Configuration or adapter existence alone is not connection proof.
build_rule: Production-ready requires a clean install from the lockfile, type/syntax checks, required test suites, production build, startup smoke or equivalent runtime verification, and rollback/recovery evidence where applicable.
speed_rule: Measure wall-clock duration for representative deterministic subsystem checks and compare to explicit generous budgets. Record regressions even when still under budget.
accuracy_rule: Deterministic correctness suites require 100% pass rate. Probabilistic/model tasks require versioned held-out fixtures, a metric appropriate to the task, a declared minimum threshold, and before/after evidence.
release_blockers: required production subsystem skipped without explicit reason
connection claimed runtime-verified without probe evidence
truth_rule: Full certification is commit- and environment-specific. DreamCo must never claim the entire repository is fully operational or fully connected unless every required dimension has current runtime evidence.
